features.name: The band
Stand the sapphire over the crown
Raise the choir: a four-claw basket with two rails
Bur the seat through to the bore
Cut the six crypt windows under the stone
Draw the plinth's plan under the shoulder
Raise the plinth, battered in to its set-off
Shape the bed under the shoulder
Lay the bed along the shoulder's slope, sunk under it
Cut the plinth's foot along the shoulder
Draw the pier's shaft on the plinth
Raise the pier's shaft
Draw a blind lancet on the shaft's outward face
Sink the lancet into the shaft
Cut the blind lancet
Draw the spire's foot on the shaft's top, turned to stand on its arrises
Draw the spire's top
Loft the spire
Draw the crockets up one arris
Raise the crockets
Turn the crockets onto all four arrises
Turn the finial's collar
Seat the collar on the spire's top
Draw the knop's section 1
Draw the knop's section 2
Draw the knop's section 3
Draw the knop's section 4
Loft the pointed knop over the collar
Draw the flyer: a raking coping over a segmental arch, from the pier to the choir
Raise the flyer across the finger
Mirror the pier and its flyer across the crown

every CAD part closed without crossings, every feature Ok
